One look at each picture. Four things come out of it.

Describe, file, find, clean. The screens below are the plugin, not a diagram of it.

01 · DESCRIBE

Alt text that knows what the page is about.

Every upload gets alt text, a caption and tags, written in your site's language. It reads the product, the category and the title you already wrote, so a skincare packshot is described as one. Review before it saves, or let it run on every upload.

02 · FILE

It proposes a folder structure and waits for you.

It reads the whole library once and shows a structure with counts. Nothing has moved. Say "drop nature, I want buildings, split into modern and classic" and it redraws. Approve, and 510 files move in one go. Undo puts every one of them back.

Your folders are ordinary WordPress categories, not rows in a table we invented. They show up in the REST API, in exports and in every other plugin that understands categories, and they are still there the day you remove us.

04 · CLEAN

The same photo, uploaded four times.

Exact copies are listed with what would break if you removed them. The kept one is used on Shop and About; the copies are used nowhere. Set-aside files stay on disk for thirty days. Same photo, different crop is a different decision, so it is listed but never touched by accident.

Unused files get their own list. Bulk rename turns IMG_4032.jpg into something you can read, for one file or a thousand, and shows you the new names before it writes them.

Coming from another plugin

The maintained successor to Enhanced Media Library.

Everything the old plugin did, kept and maintained, on the same media_category taxonomy. Folders from FileBird, Folders, WP Media Folder, HappyFiles, Wicked Folders and Real Media Library import in one click, and you can take them with you if you ever leave.

The five people ask first.

  • Do I need an API key?

    No. Nothing to set up. Credits are included in Pro and you can buy more from the plugin.

  • What happens when credits run out?

    Processing pauses. Your library keeps working. Buy a pack or wait for next year's allowance. No overage, ever.

  • Can I keep using the free version forever?

    Yes. The free version is the maintained plugin with everything the old one did.

  • Where do images go?

    To our processing service in the EU, for the seconds it takes to analyse them. They are not stored.

  • Does it work with folder plugins like FileBird?

    VergeLabs uses taxonomies, not folders. Running both is not recommended, and VergeLabs tells you if it detects one.
